issues.title: CRT: Student with Allowed CRT can open CRT; others cannot
issues.body:
## What to build
Finish the CRT entry so permission actually controls the product.

## Clear work
1. Keep `/crt` behind `crt.access`.
2. Show CRT in the navbar only when the signed-in user has Allowed CRT.
3. If someone opens `/crt` without permission, send them home with a clear message (or no CRT link).
4. Write a short note in the issue comments: how an admin grants access (Labels → Allowed CRT → add member).

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Can give a student CRT access by adding them to the **Allowed CRT** label (or any label with Allowed CRT permission). Students without that access never see CRT.
- **Student with access:** Sees **CRT** in the menu and can open the CRT page.
- **Student without access:** Does not see CRT in the menu and cannot use `/crt`.

## Done when
Demo: one allowed student enters CRT; one normal student cannot.

issues.title: CRT: Draw the student and admin screens before coding features
issues.body:
## What to build
Simple screen list + rough layout (Figma or markdown sketches).

## Clear work
Sketch at least:
1. Student CRT home
2. Practice test screen
3. Result / review screen
4. Admin: create path / add questions

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Product owner / team:** Agrees what CRT will look like before weeks of coding.
- **Admin (later):** Will get screens that match this plan (paths, questions, assign).
- **Student (later):** Will get a clear home → practice → result flow.

## Done when
Sketches are linked in this issue and approved in a short review comment.

issues.title: CRT: Database for paths, questions, and student attempts
issues.body:
## What to build
Supabase tables + RLS for CRT content and practice attempts.

## Clear work
1. Tables for learning paths, modules, questions, attempts.
2. Students can only read published content and **their own** attempts.
3. Only staff with CRT admin rights (or existing admin) can create/edit questions.
4. Seed one sample path with a few questions for demos.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Can store CRT courses and questions in the system safely.
- **Student:** Their practice answers stay private to them (and admins who need reports).
- **Team:** A real data foundation so UI work is not fake/local-only.

## Done when
Migration applied; student vs admin access tested; sample path exists.

issues.title: CRT: Admin can create a learning path and modules
issues.body:
## What to build
Admin UI to create a CRT path (example: “Service company track”) and modules inside it (Aptitude, Reasoning, Verbal…).

## Clear work
1. Create / rename / reorder modules.
2. Draft vs Published.
3. Only published paths show to students.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Can set up a full CRT training path without asking a developer to edit the database.
- **Student:** Sees only published paths, with clear module names in order.

## Done when
Admin creates “Campus Service Track” with at least 3 modules and publishes it; student can see it on CRT home.

issues.title: CRT: Admin can add MCQ questions with explanations
issues.body:
## What to build
Question bank: add MCQs with options, correct answer, topic tag, difficulty, explanation.

## Clear work
1. Add / edit / delete questions.
2. Attach questions to a module.
3. Students must not see the correct answer while the test is running.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Can build and fix CRT question papers themselves.
- **Student:** Gets real practice questions; after submit they can learn from explanations.

## Done when
At least 30 questions across 3 topics exist; student practice does not leak answers mid-test.

issues.title: CRT: Student can take a timed practice test and see score
issues.body:
## What to build
Timed practice: start → answer MCQs → timer ends or submit → score page.

## Clear work
1. Timer and question navigator.
2. Save answers (don’t lose on refresh if possible).
3. After submit: score, correct/wrong, explanations.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Can practice like a real CRT section and immediately know how they did.
- **Admin:** Can see that attempts are being recorded (for later reports).

## Done when
A student finishes one timed set and sees a clear score summary with explanations.

issues.title: CRT: Student CRT home shows progress and Continue
issues.body:
## What to build
CRT home listing assigned paths, % complete, and a Continue button.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Opens CRT and instantly knows what to do next (not a blank page).
- **Admin:** Students actually use the path that was assigned.

## Done when
Home shows path name, progress, and Continue into the next module/practice.

issues.title: CRT: Admin can import many questions from Excel/CSV
issues.body:
## What to build
Upload Excel/CSV using a fixed template; show which rows failed.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Can load hundreds of CRT questions in minutes instead of typing one by one.
- **Student:** Gets a larger practice bank faster.

## Done when
Template downloads; a sample file imports; error report shows bad rows.

issues.title: CRT: Student can take a full mock CRT (multi-section)
issues.body:
## What to build
One full mock that feels like a campus drive paper (sections + total time), then a section-wise report.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Can sit a full mock before the real placement test and see section scores (Aptitude / Reasoning / …).
- **Admin:** Can configure the mock blueprint (counts/time) once and reuse it.

## Done when
Student completes one full mock and sees section-wise results.

issues.title: CRT: Student sees a readiness score on CRT home
issues.body:
## What to build
A simple 0–100 readiness score from recent practice + mocks (document the formula).

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Knows “Am I placement-ready?” at a glance, not only last test marks.
- **Admin / mentor:** Can sort students by readiness later.

## Done when
Formula is written in the issue/docs; score updates after a practice/mock; shown on CRT home.

issues.title: CRT: Student can open past attempts and review mistakes
issues.body:
## What to build
History list of attempts; open one to review wrong answers + explanations.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Can revise weak questions after a test instead of forgetting them.
- **Admin:** Students spend more time learning, not only attempting.

## Done when
From history, student opens an old attempt and sees review (not mid-test cheating).

issues.title: CRT: Student sees topic strength/weakness (heatmap)
issues.body:
## What to build
Simple topic bars/heatmap from attempts (e.g. Percentages weak, Blood relations strong).

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Knows which topics to practice next.
- **Mentor:** Can spot class-wide weak topics later.

## Done when
After a few attempts, CRT shows topic strengths clearly.

issues.title: CRT: Admin can assign a path to a college batch
issues.body:
## What to build
Pick a ULearn batch + a CRT path → assign. Students in that batch (with CRT access) see it.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin / campus staff:** Can roll out CRT to a whole batch in one action.
- **Student:** Opens CRT and already has the path for their batch (no manual enroll chaos).

## Done when
Assign batch → student in batch sees path; student not in batch does not (unless assigned another way).

issues.title: CRT: Admin can publish a company pack (e.g. TCS / Infosys)
issues.body:
## What to build
Company pack = name + linked questions/tips. Student opens pack and practices.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Can prepare “this drive’s company” material quickly.
- **Student:** Practices the pattern for a specific company, not only generic CRT.

## Done when
At least one company pack is published and a student can practice from it.

issues.title: CRT: Admin can post CRT announcements / drive dates
issues.body:
## What to build
CRT-only announcements list (and optional drive date).

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Tells CRT students about drives/classes without emailing everyone manually.
- **Student with CRT access:** Sees placement/CRT notices in one place.
- **Student without CRT:** Does not see these notices.

## Done when
Admin posts one announcement; allowed CRT student sees it on CRT home.

issues.title: CRT: Mentor can see who is inactive or low readiness
issues.body:
## What to build
Mentor/admin table: last practice date, readiness, batch filter; export CSV.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Mentor / admin:** Finds students who stopped practicing or are below the readiness cut-off.
- **Student:** Gets help earlier because mentors can see them.

## Done when
Mentor filters a batch and exports a CSV of at-risk students.

issues.title: CRT: Mentor can assign a remedial module to selected students
issues.body:
## What to build
From mentor dashboard, assign an extra module; student sees it on CRT home until done.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Mentor:** Can push weak students into extra practice without creating a whole new path.
- **Student:** Sees a clear “Assigned for you” remedial item and can complete it.

## Done when
Mentor assigns → student sees it → completion clears/updates status.

issues.title: CRT: Admin analytics — usage funnel and bad questions
issues.body:
## What to build
Simple analytics: how many started practice / finished / mock / ready; questions with very high fail rate.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Knows if CRT is actually being used and which questions need fixing.
- **Content author:** Improves weak questions.

## Done when
Admin opens analytics and sees funnel numbers + a “fix these questions” list.

issues.title: CRT: End-to-end QA demo for product owner
issues.body:
## What to build
A written demo script + checklist, then run it live once.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Product owner:** Sees admin assign batch → student practice → mock → readiness → mentor view in one sitting.
- **Team:** Knows CRT Phase work is shippable.

## Done when
Checklist attached to this issue; demo completed; bugs filed as follow-ups.

issues.title: Interview: Student with Allowed Interview can open Interview; others cannot
issues.body:
## What to build
Same access idea as CRT, for Interview.

## Clear work
1. `/interview` only with `interview.access`.
2. Navbar link only when allowed.
3. Note how admin grants **Allowed Interview** via Labels.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Controls who may use AI mocks by label membership.
- **Student with access:** Sees **Interview** and opens it.
- **Student without access:** No Interview menu; cannot use `/interview`.

## Done when
Allowed vs not-allowed students behave as above in a demo.

issues.title: Interview: Choose AI provider and write cost/safety rules
issues.body:
## What to build
A short decision doc: which AI API, approx cost per 30-min mock, secrets only on server, safety rules.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin / owner:** Knows rough monthly cost before students spam mocks.
- **Team:** Builds without putting API keys in the browser.
- **Student (later):** Gets stable mocks without leaking exam-style answers from the AI.

## Done when
`docs` note (or issue comment) has provider choice, cost estimate, and safety list.

issues.title: Interview: Database for templates, sessions, turns, scores
issues.body:
## What to build
Supabase schema + RLS: interview templates, sessions, chat turns, scores. Seed HR + Technical templates.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Their interview chat and scores stay private to them (+ mentors/admins as designed).
- **Admin:** Can add new interview types later without rebuilding everything.

## Done when
Migration applied; seed templates exist; student cannot read another student’s session.

issues.title: Interview: Screen sketches for start, chat, and feedback
issues.body:
## What to build
Sketches for: pick interview type → live chat mock → scorecard/transcript.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Team / owner:** Agrees UX before AI work.
- **Student (later):** Clear start → interview → feedback journey.

## Done when
Sketches linked and approved on this issue.

issues.title: Interview: Student can pick an interview type and start a session
issues.body:
## What to build
Catalog of interviews (HR, Technical, …) with duration; Start creates a session.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Chooses the kind of mock they need and starts in one click.
- **Admin:** Controls which templates are available (publish/hide).

## Done when
Student starts HR and Technical from the catalog; session appears in history as in progress/completed.

issues.title: Interview: Student can complete a text AI mock (Q&A loop)
issues.body:
## What to build
Chat interview: AI asks, student types answers, AI follow-ups, timer, end session. AI calls only from backend/edge function.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Experiences a real back-and-forth mock interview in the browser.
- **Admin:** No API keys exposed; sessions are saved for feedback.

## Done when
Student finishes one full text mock; all turns are stored; timer works.

issues.title: Interview: Weekly mock limit so students cannot overuse AI
issues.body:
## What to build
Default weekly quota (configurable). Block Start when used up with a clear message.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin / owner:** Controls AI cost; one student cannot burn the budget.
- **Student:** Understands how many mocks they have left this week.

## Done when
After quota is used, Start is blocked with a friendly message; quota resets weekly (or documented rule).

issues.title: Interview: Student can see past mocks in a history list
issues.body:
## What to build
List of past sessions with date, type, status; open feedback when ready.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Finds older mocks and tracks improvement over time.
- **Mentor (later):** Can open the same history for review.

## Done when
Completed mocks show in history and open the feedback page.

issues.title: Interview: After a mock, student gets a scorecard and transcript
issues.body:
## What to build
Post-session scoring (competencies like clarity, depth, communication) + full transcript UI.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Knows overall score, strengths, and what to improve, with the full conversation to re-read.
- **Admin:** Scoring version is stored so old results stay understandable when rubrics change.

## Done when
Finishing a mock shows scorecard + transcript within a short wait.

issues.title: Interview: Admin can edit interviewer persona / prompts without code
issues.body:
## What to build
Safe admin UI (or config) to edit persona text and prompts; sessions store which version was used.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin:** Can make the AI stricter/friendlier or more “HR-like” without a developer deploy.
- **Student:** Gets consistent interviewer style for a published template.

## Done when
Admin changes persona → new session uses new text; old session still shows old version id.

issues.title: Interview: Student gets 3–5 next practice tips from weak areas
issues.body:
## What to build
On scorecard, show concrete tips (e.g. “Practice STAR stories”, “Explain trade-offs”).

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Leaves the mock knowing what to do next, not only a number.
- **CRT team (later):** Can deep-link tips to CRT topics if both products agree.

## Done when
Every completed mock shows actionable tips tied to low competencies.

issues.title: Interview: Student can redo the same mock and compare scores
issues.body:
## What to build
Redo with same template; show before/after scores.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Measures improvement on the same interview style.
- **Mentor:** Sees progress between attempts.

## Done when
Student completes two linked attempts and sees a compare view.

issues.title: Interview: Student can do a voice mock (speak answers)
issues.body:
## What to build
Voice mode: mic permission, speech-to-text answers, fallback to text if mic fails.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Practices speaking like a real interview, not only typing.
- **Admin:** Cost/latency impact is documented; quota still applies.

## Done when
Student completes one voice (or hybrid) mock; fallback to text works.

issues.title: Interview: Technical mock includes a coding question with editor
issues.body:
## What to build
In technical interviews, show a coding problem + editor + public tests; save code and result into the session score.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Practices coding under interview pressure inside the same mock.
- **Admin:** Can attach coding problems to the Technical template.

## Done when
Student runs tests during a technical mock; scorecard includes coding performance.

issues.title: Interview: Optional resume upload makes questions about the student’s projects
issues.body:
## What to build
Paste/upload resume text; AI asks at least two project-specific questions.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** Mock feels personal to their resume, closer to real interviews.
- **Admin:** Privacy note shown; resume data retention rule documented.

## Done when
With a sample resume, session includes resume-based questions.

issues.title: Interview: Mentor can review a mock and override the AI score
issues.body:
## What to build
Mentor list of completed sessions; open transcript; change score with a required reason; keep history of changes.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Mentor:** Corrects unfair AI scores and coaches with context.
- **Student:** Sees final mentor-adjusted feedback when enabled.
- **Admin:** Audit trail of who changed scores.

## Done when
Mentor overrides one score with a reason; history shows old vs new.

issues.title: Interview: Admin can see usage and estimated AI cost by college/batch
issues.body:
## What to build
Simple dashboard: sessions started/completed, average score, estimated cost.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Admin / owner:** Knows which colleges use Interview and what it costs.
- **Campus staff:** Can justify quotas or training push.

## Done when
Admin opens dashboard and exports a CSV for one college/batch filter.

issues.title: Interview: Clear errors when AI fails; session does not lose the chat so far
issues.body:
## What to build
Retries, friendly error messages, mark session failed without wiping transcript.

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Student:** If AI is down, they understand what happened and don’t lose everything typed.
- **Admin:** Fewer “mock disappeared” support complaints.

## Done when
Forced failure demo still shows prior turns and a clear error state.

issues.title: Interview: End-to-end QA demo for product owner
issues.body:
## What to build
Demo script: grant Allowed Interview → start HR mock → finish → scorecard → mentor override (if ready).

## Expected outcomes (what people get)
- **Product owner:** Sees the full Interview value in one sitting.
- **Team:** Confirms Phase work is demo-ready.

## Done when
Checklist on this issue; demo done; leftover bugs filed.
